Dear Stakeholder,
The primary purpose of this survey is to assess your opinions and expectations regarding the services we provide as the Exchange Programs Office of Gebze Technical University’s International Relations Coordination Office, to objectively determine your level of satisfaction based on your actual experiences and any issues you may have encountered, and to implement the necessary improvements accordingly. Your responses, opinions, and comments will provide valuable insights that will help us improve our services and guide our future efforts. Therefore, if you rate any statement as 1 or 2, we kindly ask you to share your comments and, where applicable, your suggestions for improvement. Your feedback will make a valuable contribution to the continuous improvement of our university's Quality Assurance System.
We kindly remind you that you can submit any additional requests through the tys.gtu.edu.tr system and thank you for your interest and valuable contributions.
Please indicate your level of agreement with the statements in the survey using the rating scale below.
5 – Strongly Agree 4 – Agree 3 – Neither Agree nor Disagree 2 – Disagree 1 – Strongly Disagree N/A – Not Applicable
